description: Change one of the baker's containers, by its id from list_my_containers: only the name, weight or notes given change, and a text given replaces the old text. No container is deleted. Needs the baker's Loafy account.

id.description: The container's id, from list_my_containers or add_container.

weight_grams.description: The empty container's weight in grams.

name: update_container

id.description: The container's id, which update_container takes.

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

saved.description: What was saved, in one sentence.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Change a container in Loafy
